'''2001 Malmö Swedish Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Malmö, Sweden on 4 August 2001. [[Alex Tennet]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2813">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ the-european-tour-2001], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Malmö, Sweden
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Tennet]]
